title: Development and Validation of an Early Prediction Model for Sepsis-Associated Multiple Organ Failure Using Ensemble Machine Learning and Feature Interaction Analysis

primary_outcome: New MOF: at least two distinct organ systems simultaneously having SOFA organ score >=2 at an hourly assessment during the horizon
exclusion: Sepsis-3 not present by prediction index
